name: The Movie Database
tagline: Community-driven movie and TV metadata API for films, people, and images
description: The Movie Database (TMDB) API provides searchable movie, TV, and person metadata including cast, crew, posters, trailers, ratings, and watch-provider info. Developers use API keys or read-access tokens to power media apps, recommendation engines, and entertainment search experiences.

auth.details: API key via api_key query param or Authorization: Bearer <v4 access token>; free self-serve signup

use_cases: fetch TV show seasons and episodes
find where to watch a title
